# Resource: tfe_registry_gpg_key

Manages a public key of the GPG key pair used to sign releases of private providers in the private registry.

The provided GPG key must be ASCII-armored, i.e. starting with: "`-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----

...`".

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic usage

resource "tfe_registry_gpg_key" "example" {
  organization = "my-org-name"
  ascii_armor  = file("my-public-key.asc")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `AsciiArmor` (String) ASCII-armored representation of the GPG key.

### Optional

- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.

### Read-Only

- `CreatedAt` (String) The time when the GPG key was created.
- `Id` (String) ID of the GPG key.
- `UpdatedAt` (String) The time when the GPG key was last updated.



## Import

Resource tfe_registry_gpg_key can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <ORGANIZATION NAME>/<KEY ID>
terraform import tfe_registry_gpg_key.example my-org-name/34365D9472D7468F
```
